title: How he made his tunes from opera; segregation and Lizzie Miles on the boat
summary: He says his tunes came from chord construction and opera, then rails against mixed bands, a jazz club boat program and Stearns's letter, defending his views on segregation.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
